# dremio_versioned_object (Data Source)

Resolves a live Nessie table or view to the stable, reference-scoped RBAC object ID. Re-read on each plan; source replacement or content recreation changes the ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Resolve the live Nessie content and source UID; never construct the RBAC ID by hand.
data "dremio_versioned_object" "sales" {
  object_type     = "PDS"
  path            = ["s", "a", "sales"]
  reference_type  = "BRANCH"
  reference_value = "main"
}

resource "dremio_grant" "sales_read" {
  object_type  = data.dremio_versioned_object.sales.grant_object_type
  object_id    = data.dremio_versioned_object.sales.id
  grantee_type = "ROLE"
  grantee_id   = dremio_role.analyst.id
  privilege   = "SELECT"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `object_type` (String) PDS for an Iceberg table or VDS for an Iceberg view.
- `path` (List of String) Catalog path components including the source name.
- `reference_type` (String)
- `reference_value` (String)

### Read-Only

- `grant_object_type` (String) VERSIONED_PDS or VERSIONED_VDS for dremio_grant/dremio_ownership.
- `id` (String) Live stable RBAC object ID. Changes when this content is recreated.
